context: Asuka discusses written language with Mei.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: linguistics chat; academic vocabulary (文字/理論/基礎/教授/参照) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 文字は、いつ生まれたんでしょう?
lines.style: soft thoughtful woman voice, gentle warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ある教授の理論では、数千年前です。
lines.en: By one professor's theory, several thousand years ago.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 文字の基礎は、絵だったんですか?
lines.en: Was the basis of characters pictures?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、絵が基礎になったという理論があります。
lines.en: Yes, there's a theory that pictures became the basis.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: その理論は、どこで読めますか?
lines.en: Where can I read that theory?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 教授の論文を、参照してみて下さい。
lines.en: Please refer to the professor's paper.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 文字の歴史、とても面白いですね。
lines.en: The history of writing is fascinating.
lines.style: delighted woman voice, soft warm bright delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 基礎を参照すれば、もっと分かりますよ。
lines.en: If you consult the basics, you'll understand more.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
